Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (memory CRUD + validation edges + cross-user 404, clone status/upload/short-reject/speak-custom-clone-engine/delete/fallback-to-sovereign/restore, engine reports xtts-v2 ready). Frontend: navbar Explore dropdown shows all 9 items (Benchmarks/Realms/Mythos/API/AI Models/Luchii Code/Constitution/Brand/About) and closes on outside click; Models/AI Court World/Developers links present; /court h1='AI Court World'; /luchii-code h1='Luchii Code' + overline 'Luchii Coder' + brand still 'Luchii'; /laws clean of 'AI World Court'; Talk pill on chat labeled 'Talk' and guest click shows sign-in toast; welcome message mentions 'Talk button'; Profile Memory Manager add/edit/forget flows work end-to-end (verified new fact appears, edited fact persists, forget removes it); My Sovereign Voice card renders with voice-clone-record-btn (visible + 'CLONED VOICE ACTIVE' badge since admin has a sample); VoicePicker shows 9 rows including voice-option-custom ('My Voice') only because admin's clone sample exists; engine-status-badge='Sovereign Engine Online'; attach menu retains 4 options.

critical.issue: espeak-ng is a hard system dependency but is NOT installed in the container image. On backend cold-start, _ensure_system_deps tries 'apt-get install -y espeak-ng' but this can fail silently (proxy/network) leaving _state['tts']='unavailable'. Worse, voice_engine.speak() at L184 returns None immediately if tts != 'ready' WITHOUT calling _load_tts() again — so /api/voice/speak permanently falls back to OpenAI 'bridge' (audio/mp3) even after espeak-ng becomes available, until backend restart. Repro: fresh container -> engine reports tts.status='unavailable' -> speak returns engine 'bridge'. Fix (either): (a) add espeak-ng to Dockerfile/apt install list, (b) retry _load_tts() from within speak() when state != 'ready', (c) fail-fast on startup if _ensure_system_deps returns non-zero.

minor.issue: cloning status flips idle→loading→ready roughly 60-90s after backend start; during that window POST /api/voice/speak with voice='custom' silently falls back to plain sovereign VITS (engine 'frasberg-sovereign') instead of the clone. Consider queueing/awaiting XTTS readiness in clone_speak or returning 503 'clone engine warming' so the client can retry.
Bounds use strict '3 < len < 300' — length 3 and length 300 are both rejected. Docs/testids suggest '4 to 300 chars'. Consider '3 < len <= 300' if 300 is the intended inclusive upper bound.

ui_bugs.issue: Text sweep missed one occurrence: 'The AI World Court will then deliver a full ruling.' (Court.jsx line 154-156, string wraps across two source lines so grep on the exact phrase in one line misses it). Should be 'The AI Court World...'.

action_items: Add espeak-ng to Dockerfile apt install list (system dep for Coqui VITS phonemizer) and/or make voice_engine.speak() retry _load_tts on 'unavailable' state — currently sovereign TTS permanently degrades to OpenAI bridge if espeak isn't present at startup.
Fix Court.jsx hero paragraph: change 'The AI World Court will then deliver a full ruling.' → 'The AI Court World will then deliver a full ruling.' (Court.jsx L154-156).
Consider changing memory validation to '3 < len(fact) <= 300' if 300 chars is intended to be valid (currently 300 is rejected).
critical_code_review_comments: voice_engine.speak() (L183-185): early return on state!='ready' has no self-heal path. Once state=='unavailable' at boot (espeak missing), no request can recover it without a full backend restart — silently switches to OpenAI bridge (mp3, non-sovereign) forever.

server.py L648-655: when XTTS is still 'loading', voice='custom' falls through to plain VITS with no signal to the client that the clone was skipped. A client asking for their cloned voice will get a different voice with no indication.
server.py L689 & L708: '3 < len(fact) < 300' — inclusive-vs-exclusive off-by-one on the upper bound (300 rejected). Also error message says '4-300 characters' but actually accepts 4..299.

rca of the issue: Two independent issues: (1) TEXT: Court.jsx has a wrap-around string 'The AI\nWorld Court will then deliver a full ruling.' — spans two source lines so a naive one-line grep for 'AI World Court' missed it during E1's sweep. Fix: reword to 'The AI Court World...'. (2) SOVEREIGN TTS DEGRADATION: espeak-ng is not in the container's baseline packages; voice_engine.py's _ensure_system_deps attempts a runtime apt-get install but if that fails (or hasn't yet completed when preload_sync runs the first _load_tts), _state['tts'] latches to 'unavailable'. voice_engine.speak() returns early without retrying — server.py then falls back to OpenAI TTS (engine='bridge', mp3), silently violating the 'sovereign' guarantee. Fix: bake espeak-ng into the image AND add a retry inside voice_engine.speak when state != 'ready'.
